emails.subject: July month-end close checklist - status and open items
emails.body:
Hi Ravi,

Ahead of tomorrow's July close, here is where the checklist stands as of this afternoon.

Done: GLCore sub-ledger cutoff confirmed for 6:00 pm tonight, accrual postings for custody fees loaded, and the nostro statements for the two USD accounts matched to the ledger with no breaks over $5,000.

Open: three aged items on the ReconLegacy end-of-day batch still show as unmatched. Two relate to SettlementEngine timing differences from Tuesday and one is a manual journal on the brokerage cash sweep for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00323}}. Wayne and Brian are clearing the settlement-side items by noon tomorrow.

I also need your sign-off on the suspense account write-back before we lock the period. Please also confirm whether Martin's team wants the flash recon pack by 10 am or 2 pm.

I will send the final checklist with initials once the break count is zero.

Thanks,
Tasha

emails.subject: Corporate action processing - cash dividend and stock split elections for week of Aug 3
emails.body:
Brian, Tasha,

Quick rundown of what hits us this week on corporate actions.

1. Mandatory cash dividends: payable Wednesday on a basket of large-cap names. I have the entitlement files from the custodian and I am validating record-date positions in PositionStore against the custodian holdings. Two mismatches so far, both small share-count differences caused by late trade bookings.

2. 3-for-1 forward split: effective Thursday. PricingSvc needs the adjustment factor loaded before the open or OMS will show stale prices. I have asked Engineering to confirm that load.

3. Voluntary tender offer: the election deadline is Friday at 5 pm ET. The election for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0155}} on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00323}} is still pending the client's instruction through the advisor.

Brian, can you take the tender election follow-ups and chase the advisor today? Tasha, please watch for dividend cash landing in GLCore against the expected amounts.

I will post any breaks in #recon.

Wayne

emails.subject: Failed settlement follow-up - Little Group DVP trade from Aug 10
emails.body:
Ravi, Wayne,

Following up on the failed DVP settlement from Monday, August 10 with Little Group ({{CP_ACCOUNT:cp_006}}). The trade was for a $4.2M block of corporate bonds and failed on settlement date because the counterparty's delivery instruction did not match ours on the settlement date field.

Status: the counterparty has since corrected and re-affirmed the instruction. The new settlement date is tomorrow, August 13. I confirmed in SettlementEngine that the trade is back in the pending queue and cash is reserved in GLCore, so there is no overdraft exposure.

Cost: accrued interest on the delay is about $1,150, and we are discussing with the counterparty who bears it under the market claims convention. I will keep Ravi updated.

Ask: Wayne, please double check our SSI database for any other open trades with this counterparty carrying the same mismatched field. I will send an update after settlement confirms tomorrow.

Thanks,
Brian

emails.subject: Corporate action processing - Q3 readiness and September 21 events
emails.body:
Team,

We have a heavy corporate action week starting today, and after the July announcement mix-up I want us tighter on controls.

Events this week: a merger with a cash and stock election (deadline Thursday), two rights issues, and the quarterly index rebalance dividends. Wealth has clients exposed to the merger, including {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0296}} on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00596}}, so elections need to be confirmed with the advisors before we submit.

Controls I expect:
- Every event gets an independent second review of the entitlement calculation before booking.
- Position snapshots from PositionStore are taken at record date close and saved to the shared folder.
- Any difference over $10,000 between custodian and internal entitlements gets flagged to me and to Owen's team in Risk.

Wayne owns the merger, Brian the rights issues, and Tasha the dividend reconciliation. Please send me a one-line status each day by 4 pm.

Thanks,
Ravi

emails.subject: September month-end close checklist - Q3 quarter-end version
emails.body:
Hi Ravi,

Attached to this note is the quarter-end close checklist for September. It adds a few steps beyond a normal month-end.

Key timing:
- Sept 30, 6:00 pm: GLCore cutoff for trade-date postings
- Oct 1, 9:00 am: ReconLegacy batch run, then break review
- Oct 1, 3:00 pm: Flash recon pack to Martin's team

Added quarter-end items: confirm all corporate action cash from the Sept 21 week has been posted, reconcile the PaymentsGateway outgoing wires to the ledger with Craig, and clear any failed-settlement accruals still open. The cash management sweep for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00324}} also needs a manual interest accrual check.

Risks: ReconLegacy is slow on quarter-end volume, so I asked Engineering to keep Oracle maintenance off the calendar overnight. Please let me know if you want anyone from Settlements on call after hours.

Thanks,
Tasha
